Name: Pause Time in Multiplayer
Author: jorgamun
Description:
[size=3]This is a non-intrusive mod that pauses time in multiplayer games when all players meet the conditions that would pause time if they were in a single-player game. A few other mods exist on here with this functionality, but they had some bugs and lack of implementation that I wasn't happy with so I made this one.

[b][size=5]Additional Features
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Stops food and drink buffs from ticking down while the game is paused.[/size]
[*][size=3]Locks monster positions and player health while paused.[/size]
[*][size=3]Slows down clock time if all players are in the Skull Cavern as it does in single-player.[/size]
[*][size=3]Displays a subtle X graphic over the game clock to better indicate when time is paused.[/size]
[*][size=3]Vote pause function, where if all players vote to toggle pause (default key: Pause/Break) then the game will pause until one of them votes to toggle pause again.[/size]
[*][size=3]Pause override hotkey (default: Scroll Lock), allowing the host to manually toggle pausing the game regardless of status or votes[/size]
[*][size=3]Optional setting to pause time when any player is in a cutscene (disabled by default)[/size]

[/list][size=3][b]
Each player must have this mod installed for it to function properly.[/b]
If each player meets any of the following conditions then time is paused:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]has a menu open[/size]
[*][size=3]is engaged in dialogue[/size]
[*][size=3]is shopping[/size]
[*][size=3]is processing geodes[/size]
[*][size=3]is in the animation of pulling crops[/size]
[*][size=3]is changing map locations[/size]
[*][size=3]is in an event[/size]
[*][size=3]is reeling in fish[/size]
[*][size=3]is playing an arcade game[/size]
[*][size=3]is playing darts[/size]
[*][size=3]is playing the crane game[/size]
[*][size=3]is watching a movie[/size]
[*][size=3]is gambling[/size]
[*][size=3]is being asked to use an item (such as eating food)[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]Time will also pause while all players have voted to or while the host has used their pause override hotkey, in addition to these conditions.[/size][size=3] If the host has enabled it, time will also pause when any player is in a cutscene.

The game clock will stop advancing when time is paused. NPCs, farm animals, and monsters will lock positions.

[b][color=#00ff00][size=4][size=3]Monsters [/size][/size][/color][color=#ffff00][color=#ff0000][color=#ffff00][color=#00ff00]and player hitpoints lock as of 1.4.0.[/color]
[/color][/color][/color][/b]This feature is new and while I've tested it, if you have any bugs please let me know![/size]

[b][size=5]Installation Instructions
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the contents of PauseInMultiplayer.zip to your StardewValley/Mods folder [i]for every player [/i](take care to use the same version for every player also)[/size]
[/list][b][size=5]
Optional Configuration
[/size][/b][size=3]Included with the mod is config.json, which allows you to set different values depending on your preference.
This may be configured by manually editing the file or by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[code]{
  "ShowPauseX": true, //change to false if you don't want to display the X graphic when paused
  "FixSkullTime": true, //change to false to disable the Skull Cavern time fix (host only)
  "DisableSkullShaftFix": false, //change to true to disable hp fix for dropping down shafts
  "LockMonsters": true, //change to false to disable monster and hp locking (host only)
  "AnyCutscenePauses": false, //change to true to pause for all cutscenes (host only)
  "EnableVotePause": true, //change to false to disable pause voting (host only)
  "VotePauseHotkey": "Pause", //change to whatever hotkey you want to toggle vote pause
  "EnablePauseOverride": true, //change to false to disable pause override hotkey (host only)
  "PauseOverrideHotkey": "Scroll", //change to whatever hotkey to pause override (host only)
  "DisplayVotePauseMessages": true //change to false to disable showing vote messages
}
[/code][/size]
